name: Skip NPE (New Player Experience)
description: Applies the exact verified 136-node Skip Tutorial state, fully completing A New Beginning without leaving research-gated objectives active.

name: Complete: A New Beginning
description: Applies the exact verified NPE completion state for the full main-story intro, including every research-gated objective.

name: Complete: Find the Fremen (Trials of Aql)
description: All 7 trials, the Sietch, and Epilogue. Unlocks the Fremkit (Stillsuit, Thumper, Cryss Knife, etc.), completes Act 1, and now also applies the Find the Fremen reward-unblock that opens the 3rd active-ability slot and prescience. Player must be offline; takes effect on next login.

name: Complete Act 1
description: Exact 136-node NPE completion + Find the Fremen. Player starts ready for Act 2 without partial tutorial research state.

name: Complete Act 2
description: Complete Assassin’s Handbook and The Great Convention. Takes effect on next login.

name: Complete Act 3
description: Complete The Great Convention, Part II (Chapter 3). Takes effect on next login.

name: Complete Act 4 — The Great Convention, Part III
description: Complete The Great Convention, Part III, including Dangerous Allies. Takes effect on next login.

name: Complete Lost Harvest
description: Complete the Lost Harvest journey. Takes effect on next login.

name: Complete Scourge
description: Complete the Scourge story contract chain through Patient Zero. Repeatable daily contracts remain separate.

name: Skip: Vermillius Gap Tutorials
description: Completes all Vermillius Gap tutorial quests (research, crafting, exploration). No tag side effects - pure tutorial skip.

name: Skip: Deep Desert Intro
description: Completes the Deep Desert side quest chain.

name: Skip: Overland Map Intro
description: Completes the Overland map side quest chain (Hark Landsraad missions, keystones).

name: Unlock All Lore (Dunipedia)
description: Reveals all Dunipedia entries: Known Universe, Landmarks, Manual of the Friendly Desert, War for Arrakis.

name: Complete Atreides faction journeys
description: Complete the selected faction’s journey lines, including its Rank 20 mission. Reputation and allegiance are unchanged.

name: Complete Harkonnen faction journeys
description: Complete the selected faction’s journey lines, including its Rank 20 mission. Reputation and allegiance are unchanged.
